application.name: PCL Filters
application.description: Filters point clouds on the GPU with holoscan-pcl-filters: a synthetic depth camera over a known scene is deprojected by holoscan-point-cloud's DepthToPointCloudOp, cropped, cleared of outliers and of the ground (RANSAC) and voxel-downsampled, every frame checked against the scene's truth, and the voxels shown in HoloViz.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-pcl-filters demo, with a synthetic scene, a ground-truth reporter and a HoloViz view.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Filter 300 frames of the synthetic scene, check each against its truth, and show the voxels above the ground when a display is available.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic 640x480 frames through the crop box, radius outlier removal, RANSAC ground removal and a 2 cm voxel grid; the plane, the ground, objects and outliers left, and the voxel count checked against the truth.
